description: A boxy polymer service pistol with all the personality of a kettle. Ferris never advertised, never changed the design, and never apologised for either. It does not jam. It has never jammed. Somewhere under the rust of the old world there is a warehouse of these still waiting to not jam.
name: Ferris Model 9 service pistol
